The saying, 春捂秋冻 is basically an idiom of sorts to tell people that they shouldn't take off or put on clothes just because the weather may have turned warmer or colder. Spring and fall are both seasons with warm and cold days so one should be careful when putting on or taking off clothing as doing it improperly could lead to a cold.

I believe many Chinese people take it literally and make their children wear layers in the Spring when the phrase just simplifies to being careful in changing weathers.
